description: Set the configuration values for model invocation logging.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1562.008 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs

researchLinks.description: We Found Eight Attack Vectors Inside AWS Bedrock. Here's What Attackers Can Do with Them

securityImplications: Attackers might use PutModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration to redirect Bedrock model-invocation logs to a bucket they control, silently capturing every prompt and response while removing the victim's audit trail.
